controls.title: Password policy requirement
controls.description: Checks whether the required password policy is configured.

controls.title: Minimum password length
controls.description: Checks the configured minimum password length.

controls.title: Account lockout threshold
controls.description: Checks whether an appropriate account lockout threshold is configured.
controls.remediation: Configure the account lockout threshold according to the selected CIS benchmark.

controls.title: Guest account status
controls.description: Checks whether the guest account is disabled.

controls.title: Firewall configuration
controls.description: Checks whether the host firewall is enabled.
controls.remediation: Enable the host firewall and verify the required firewall policies.

controls.title: Audit policy configuration
controls.description: Checks the system audit policy configuration.

controls.title: Remote access configuration
controls.description: Checks whether remote access settings follow the benchmark.
controls.remediation: Review and restrict remote access according to organizational policy.

controls.title: Security event logging
controls.description: Checks whether security event logging is enabled.

controls.title: Log retention configuration
controls.description: Checks whether event log retention meets the required configuration.
controls.remediation: Increase event log retention according to the applicable CIS requirement.

controls.title: System update configuration
controls.description: Checks whether automatic security updates are configured.

controls.title: Unused services
controls.description: Checks for unnecessary services.

controls.title: Administrative privileges
controls.description: Checks whether unnecessary administrative privileges exist.
controls.remediation: Review local administrator membership and remove unnecessary privileges.

controls.title: Screen lock policy
controls.description: Checks whether automatic screen locking is configured.

controls.title: USB device policy
controls.description: Checks removable device configuration.

controls.title: Antivirus configuration
controls.description: Checks whether antivirus protection is enabled.

controls.title: Antivirus updates
controls.description: Checks whether antivirus definitions are updated.

controls.title: Network security settings
controls.description: Checks important network security settings.

controls.title: Encryption configuration
controls.description: Checks whether required encryption settings are enabled.

controls.title: Security service availability
controls.description: The required security service could not be queried.
controls.remediation: Verify that the required service exists and that the audit process has sufficient permissions.

controls.title: System configuration integrity
controls.description: Checks important system configuration values.
